title: chore(osv): dated exemption for minimatch GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 until 2026-11-30
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XQuFgZcNu7SjjmAugk2cHWw)_
Part of #28292

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：在 `osv-scanner.toml` 台账里加一条 `minimatch` 公告 GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 的豁免，到期日 2026-11-30（默认 30 天），不改任何代码或依赖。
- **为什么改**：这条公告只在 `minimatch` 11 修复，11 是破坏性大版本，所有父包的最新版都还只接受 10；按台账惯例 3，豁免单独开 PR 并打 `osv-exemption` 标签。
- **风险与回滚**：接受一条已知的中危（只影响可用性）公告 30 天。已读过已发布包的可达路径，结论在席位评审里。到期后扫描自动转红；回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**：`osv-scanner.toml` 末尾新加的那一块（理由句与到期日）。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/check-osv-exemptions.mjs`，应见 `2 OSV exemption(s) ... all carry an unexpired ignoreUntil within 90 days`。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- One `[[IgnoredVulns]]` entry in `osv-scanner.toml` for `minimatch` GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249, in the ledger's template shape: `ignoreUntil = 2026-11-30` (a bare TOML date, the 30-day default) and a `reason` in convention 2's format (the advisory URL, then one sentence on what blocks the fix).
- Nothing else. No dependency moves, no package publishes from this file, so the PR carries `skip-changeset`.

## Why

- The scheduled OSV scan on `main` is red on four advisories (#28292). PR #28324 clears `glob`, `follow-redirects` and `joi`. This PR is the dated exemption for the fourth, as triage routed it: "`minimatch` 11 moves only where its parents accept it; otherwise it needs its own exemption PR with a reason."
- Every `minimatch` before 11.0.1 is affected, and 11 is a breaking major (its types drop `makeRe`, `AST` and two options).
- Re-read on the npm registry on 2026-10-31 at this PR's base: no parent's newest release accepts 11.

| Parent (latest) | declares `minimatch` |
|:--|:--|
| eslint 10.14.0 | ^10.2.6 |
| @eslint/config-array 0.23.5 | ^10.2.4 |
| @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree 8.72.1 | ^10.2.2 |
| @microsoft/api-extractor 7.60.1 | 10.2.3 (exact) |
| @oclif/core 5.1.10 | ^10.2.5 |
| @ts-morph/common 0.29.0 | ^10.0.1 |
| typedoc 0.28.20 | ^10.2.5 |
| readdir-glob 3.0.0 | ^10.2.2 |

- The `pnpm-workspace.yaml` override `'minimatch@<11.0.0': '^10.2.3'` already holds every copy on 10.2.6, the newest 10.x (`pnpm why minimatch -r --prod`: one version, 10.2.6). Retargeting it to 11 would force a major outside every parent's range.
- Shipped reach read; see the seat's review. A request-influenced pattern reaches it: no.
- Not a blanket exemption: one advisory id, 30 days. When it expires the scanner stops filtering it and the gate turns red on its own.

## Tests

Run at head `469d5358`.

- `node scripts/check-osv-exemptions.mjs --self-test`: exit 0 (`self-test passed: valid ledgers accepted, every convention breach rejected.`).
- `node scripts/check-osv-exemptions.mjs`: exit 0 (`2 OSV exemption(s) in osv-scanner.toml: all carry an unexpired ignoreUntil within 90 days and a reason with an advisory link.`).

## Acceptance notes

- No new tests and no ablation: the diff is one ledger entry, and the ledger's own checker is the test.
- `pnpm lint` scoped to touched packages: none, since the diff touches no package (`osv-scanner.toml` is a repo-root file that eslint does not read).
- Removal condition, for renewal time: drop the entry when those parents accept `minimatch` 11.0.1 or later.

The OSV-Scanner binary download and `api.osv.dev` are both refused by this container's egress policy. The affected range (introduced 0, fixed 11.0.1) was read from the osv.dev advisory page. The PR's own base-relative OSV step judges it in CI.

</details>
